summary: The base workplace plus the tool-chains a developer agent builds with: PHP, Java, native npm builds, and version managers for Flutter/Dart and Python.

tools.name: php
tools.note: with xml, mbstring, curl, zip, gd, ldap, sqlite3, mysql, pgsql, bcmath, intl, and pcov as the coverage driver

tools.name: openjdk
tools.note: JAVA_HOME=/opt/java; gradlew downloads its own Gradle

tools.name: build-essential, python3
tools.note: so npm packages with a native part (sharp, bcrypt, node-sass) build instead of failing halfway

tools.name: chromium
tools.note: used by the browser plugin, headless

sdk_dirs.fvm: ~/fvm — Flutter/Dart SDKs. fvm is installed; the SDKs are NOT in the image, they live in your home and survive every run. `fvm use` once per project.
sdk_dirs.uv: ~/.local/share/uv — Python interpreters. uv is installed; it fetches the version a project asks for.

notes: Java and Flutter are already here. Do not download a JDK or a Flutter SDK into your home — you would be carrying a second copy of something the workplace provides, and your home is written back after every run.
You are not root and apt is not available to you. If a tool is missing, say so instead of building a way around it — that is a request, not a defeat.
